properties.displayName: CCC.Core.CN11 - AKS clusters must encrypt etcd secrets with a customer-managed key in a private key vault (KMS)
properties.description: Audits AKS managed clusters that do not enable the Azure Key Vault KMS provider with a private key vault. KMS encrypts Kubernetes secrets in etcd with a customer-managed key (CMEK); requiring keyVaultNetworkAccess = Private keeps the key vault off the public internet (reached via the trusted-services bypass). Maps to FINOS CCC Core CN11 (Protect Encryption Keys) and enforces the AVM aks sample setting 'security_profile.azure_key_vault_kms' with key_vault_network_access = Private.

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy.
